versions.changelog: Correct canonical MCP URL and three category, task and problem search-answer samples.

- Initial release of Findable skill for website SEO/AEO audits.
- Provides public website audits and sourced SEO/AEO content drafts without requiring an account or private data.
- Audits homepage, internal pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and competitor sites.
- Includes sourced public business contacts and detailed, actionable audit reports.
- Offers audit request and status check API via Findable’s MCP server.
